title: IT Helpdesk Ticketing System
summary: A web-based helpdesk where staff report IT problems and the IT team assigns, tracks and resolves them in one place.
builtFor: The IT office of a local school
overview: IT requests used to come in through chat messages, phone calls and walk-ins, so some were lost and few were followed up. The system gives every request a ticket with a category, a priority, an owner and a status.
Staff submit tickets through a short form. The IT team works from a ticket queue and a dashboard that shows open work and the kinds of problems that come up most often.
features: Ticket form with categories for network, printer, computer, LMS and database issues
Status workflow: New, In progress, Closed
Low, medium and high priority levels
Admin dashboard with charts by status, priority, category and history
Reports and user management with roles
In-app notifications for new and updated tickets

title: AI Plagiarism & Paraphrasing Checker
summary: Checks pasted text or uploaded documents for similarity and returns a percentage score, with an optional paraphrasing step.
overview: Checking written work for originality by hand is slow. This tool lets a user paste text or upload a document and get a similarity score in a few seconds.
An optional paraphrasing step rewrites the text before the check, so writers can improve their wording and see how the score changes.
features: Paste text or upload a document
Similarity score shown as a percentage
Text comparison using natural language processing

title: MiroMail
summary: An email app connected to Gmail, with a rich-text editor, a visual design mode for branded emails, and scheduled sending.
builtFor: Small businesses and teams that send branded emails
overview: Designing a good-looking email usually means switching between a design tool and an email client. MiroMail does both in one place.
Users sign in with Gmail, write in a rich-text editor or switch to a visual design mode, then send right away or schedule the email for later.
features: Gmail integration for inbox, sent mail, drafts and trash
Visual design mode for branded emails
Scheduled sending with a date and time picker
